        <p id="IDX-detailsDescription">    Timeless character & thoughtful updates, this 3 bedroom, 1 bath 1920's home features beautifully refinished hardwood floors, classic built-ins, and original details that showcase the craftsmanship of the era. The spacious kitchen with lots of cabinet and counter space, along with nostalgic pops of orange, green, and yellow that give the space a fun vintage feel. A nearby enclosed porch provides space for the washer and dryer along with a sunny area perfect for plants or a possible plant-lovers setup. There is a main-level primary bedroom and remodeled full bathroom, with two additional bedrooms upstairs. Unfinished basement provides plenty of storage and additional possibilities. Fresh interior and exterior paint, refreshed plaster, an updated bathroom, and sewer upgrades. and central HVAC. Detached 2-car garage with workshop space plus an additional carport, plus fenced yard with garden area. A wonderful combination of 1920s Craftsman charm and useful updates.
</p>
